The api died at 03:14:06 because the data disk filled up, and it never came back for the rest of the log. Note the log covers 2026-03-09 02:00–05:30, not last night, so check this is the file you meant.

**What happened**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 03:05:00 | `report-export` job starts writing 512 MB CSV parts to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 seconds |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%` |
| 03:12:48 | Last export part written (40 parts, about 20 GB in under 8 minutes) |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%` |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool` |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` |
| 03:16:00 onward | `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes, 67 times, last at 05:28:00 |

**Cause**

The export job filled the volume that Postgres also writes to. When the database could not extend a data file, the api aborted its transaction, shut down its worker pool and exited.

**Recovery**

- **No recovery in the log:** the last successful api request is at 03:13:51, and the proxy was still getting refused connections when the log ends at 05:29:57. That is at least 2h15m of outage.
- **No restart visible:** the compose file sets `restart: unless-stopped` on the api, but the log shows no api startup lines at all after the exit. I can't tell from this file whether it wasn't restarted or was crash-looping silently.
- **Web and proxy stayed up:** both kept returning 200s throughout, so only api-backed requests failed.

**Not related**

The `cache: slow command` warnings (100–149 ms, roughly every 5 minutes) run at the same rate before and after the crash, so they are background noise.

**Next steps**

Free up the space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` and restart the api. To prevent a repeat, the export job needs either its own volume or a size cap, since nothing stopped it between the 91% warning and the disk filling five minutes later. I didn't find the `report-export` job defined anywhere in `app/` or `scripts/`, so it lives outside this repo.
